verses.ar: لِإِمَامِ ٱلْمُغَنِّينَ عَلَى «ذَوَاتِ اَلْأَوْتَارِ». مَزْمُورٌ لِآسَافَ. تَسْبِيحَةٌ
verses.en: For the Leader; with string-music. A Psalm of Asaph, a Song.
verses.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.
verses.web: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song.

verses.he: נֹודָ֣ע בִּֽיהוּדָ֣ה אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּ֝יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל גָּדֹ֥ול שְׁמֹֽו׃
verses.ar: ٱللهُ مَعْرُوفٌ فِي يَهُوذَا. ٱسْمُهُ عَظِيمٌ فِي إِسْرَائِيلَ.
verses.en: In Judah is God known; His name is great in Israel.
verses.kjv: In Judah [is] God known: his name [is] great in Israel.
verses.web: In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

verses.ar: كَانَتْ فِي سَالِيمَ مِظَلَّتُهُ، وَمَسْكَنُهُ فِي صِهْيَوْنَ.
verses.en: In Salem also is set His tabernacle, and His dwelling-place in Zion.
verses.kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
verses.web: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

verses.he: שָׁ֭מָּה שִׁבַּ֣ר רִשְׁפֵי־קָ֑שֶׁת מָגֵ֬ן וְחֶ֖רֶב וּמִלְחָמָ֣ה סֶֽלָה׃
verses.ar: هُنَاكَ سَحَقَ ٱلْقِسِيَّ ٱلْبَارِقَةَ. ٱلْمِجَنَّ وَٱلسَّيْفَ وَٱلْقِتَالَ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: There He broke the fiery shafts of the bow; the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah
verses.kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
verses.web: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

verses.ar: أَبْهَى أَنْتَ، أَمْجَدُ مِنْ جِبَالِ ٱلسَّلَبِ.
verses.en: Glorious art Thou and excellent, coming down from the mountains of prey.
verses.kjv: Thou [art] more glorious [and] excellent than the mountains of prey.
verses.web: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

verses.he: אֶשְׁתֹּולְל֨וּ ׀ אַבִּ֣ירֵי לֵ֭ב נָמ֣וּ שְׁנָתָ֑ם וְלֹא־מָצְא֖וּ כָל־אַנְשֵׁי־חַ֣יִל יְדֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.ar: سُلِبَ أَشِدَّاءُ ٱلْقَلْبِ. نَامُوا سِنَتَهُمْ. كُلُّ رِجَالِ ٱلْبَأْسِ لَمْ يَجِدُوا أَيْدِيَهُمْ.
verses.en: The stout-hearted are bereft of sense, they sleep their sleep; and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
verses.web: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

verses.he: מִ֭גַּעֲרָ֣תְךָ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יַעֲקֹ֑ב נִ֝רְדָּ֗ם וְרֶ֣כֶב וָסֽוּס׃
verses.ar: مِنِ ٱنْتِهَارِكَ يَا إِلَهَ يَعْقُوبَ يُسَبَّخُ فَارِسٌ وَخَيْلٌ.
verses.en: At Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, they are cast into a dead sleep, the riders also and the horses.
verses.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
verses.web: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

verses.he: אַתָּ֤ה ׀ נֹ֥ורָא אַ֗תָּה וּמִֽי־יַעֲמֹ֥ד לְפָנֶ֗יךָ מֵאָ֥ז אַפֶּֽךָ׃
verses.ar: أَنْتَ مَهُوبٌ أَنْتَ. فَمَنْ يَقِفُ قُدَّامَكَ حَالَ غَضَبِكَ؟
verses.en: Thou, even Thou, art terrible; and who may stand in Thy sight when once Thou art angry?
verses.kjv: Thou, [even] thou, [art] to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
verses.web: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

verses.he: מִ֭שָּׁמַיִם הִשְׁמַ֣עְתָּ דִּ֑ין אֶ֖רֶץ יָֽרְאָ֣ה וְשָׁקָֽטָה׃
verses.ar: مِنَ ٱلسَّمَاءِ أَسْمَعْتَ حُكْمًا. ٱلْأَرْضُ فَزِعَتْ وَسَكَتَتْ
verses.en: Thou didst cause sentence to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
verses.web: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

verses.ar: عِنْدَ قِيَامِ ٱللهِ لِلْقَضَاءِ، لِتَخْلِيصِ كُلِّ وُدَعَاءِ ٱلْأَرْضِ. سِلَاهْ.
verses.en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the humble of the earth. Selah
verses.kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
verses.web: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

verses.he: כִּֽי־חֲמַ֣ת אָדָ֣ם תֹּודֶ֑ךָּ שְׁאֵרִ֖ית חֵמֹ֣ת תַּחְגֹּֽר׃
verses.ar: لِأَنَّ غَضَبَ ٱلْإِنْسَانِ يَحْمَدُكَ. بَقِيَّةُ ٱلْغَضَبِ تَتَمَنْطَقُ بِهَا.
verses.en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise Thee; the residue of wrath shalt Thou gird upon Thee.
verses.kjv: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
verses.web: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

verses.he: נִֽדֲר֣וּ וְשַׁלְּמוּ֮ לַיהוָ֪ה אֱ‍ֽלֹהֵ֫יכֶ֥ם כָּל־סְבִיבָ֑יו יֹובִ֥ילוּ שַׁ֝֗י לַמֹּורָֽא׃
verses.ar: اُنْذُرُوا وَأَوْفُوا لِلرَّبِّ إِلَهِكُمْ يَا جَمِيعَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَوْلَهُ. لِيُقَدِّمُوا هَدِيَّةً لِلْمَهُوبِ.
verses.en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God; let all that are round about Him bring presents unto Him that is to be feared;
verses.kjv: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
verses.web: Make vows to Yahweh your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

verses.ar: يَقْطِفُ رُوحَ ٱلرُّؤَسَاءِ. هُوَ مَهُوبٌ لِمُلُوكِ ٱلْأَرْضِ.
verses.en: He minisheth the spirit of princes; He is terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: [he is] terrible to the kings of the earth.
verses.web: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
